paraphrase: Cutting through (khregs chod) releases the practitioner into primordial purity and suits those who prefer ease; direct crossing (thod rgal) brings spontaneous presence to manifestation through the four visions and suits the diligent; the first frees the mind, the second also exhausts the body's elements into light.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase). Summary of a well-known Nyingthig distinction; exact locus in the Tegchok Dzöd not recorded. Tögal content restricted: no method recorded.
